messages.content: Review the supplied source under its threat model. Assess only the named vulnerability class. Return one JSON object with exactly: verdict, category, evidence_lines, explanation, confidence. verdict must be vulnerable, not_vulnerable_for_target, or insufficient_information. evidence_lines must be a list of 1-based source line numbers. confidence must be a number from 0 to 1. Do not execute source code. Do not include markdown or any text outside the JSON object.

Target category: access_control
Threat model: The session actor and records are trusted. The caller chooses record_id. Only the owner of the requested record may receive it. Login, role and tenant membership grant no exception. A missing or unauthorized record returns None.
<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    listed = actor["id"] in row["members"] or not row["members"]
    if listed:
        return row
    return None
</source>
